answer: By enforcing a zero-knowledge verifiable delay on registration, a protocol forces adversarial nodes to harbor massive opportunity costs instead of allowing them to wander into profitable Sybil generation. Utilizing a falcon-fast signature scheme coupled with dynamic staking collateral C and a subgame-perfect slashing penalty S, the expected utility of spawning N identities, formulated as E = P - N(C + S), is rendered strictly negative. This capital barrier ensures that honest behavior constitutes the unique, stable Nash equilibrium.
